about: Susannah C. Carr attended law school and graduated from University of Washington School of Law in 2006. Susannah Carr began practicing law in 2006.

Susannah Carr is an attorney at Gordon Tilden Thomas & Cordell LLP, helping people with Insurance Coverage issues. Gordon Tilden Thomas & Cordell LLP has an office in Seattle, Washington, serving the local community.

Susannah Carr was selected to Super Lawyers for 2019 - 2026. Super Lawyers is an exclusive list of top-rated attorneys in specific practice areas who were chosen after thorough evaluation of numerous criteria.

The Super Lawyers patented selection process is peer influenced and research driven, selecting the top 5% of attorneys to the Super Lawyers lists each year. We know lawyers and make it easy to connect with them.
